sql: ALTER TABLE marketplace_resources ADD COLUMN owner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Owner user ID copied from the associated Kind resource' DEFAULT '0'

UPDATE marketplace_resources
            SET owner_user_id = (
                SELECT kinds.user_id
                FROM kinds
                WHERE kinds.id = marketplace_resources.kind_id
            )
CREATE INDEX idx_marketplace_resources_owner_type_updated ON marketplace_resources (owner_user_id, resource_type, updated_at, kind_id)
ALTER TABLE marketplace_resources DROP COLUMN owner_user_id
